GenericConnectorDescriptor.description: Send text-based documents to the JEV decision API and receive structured, confidence-gated results.

field.label: Base URL
field.helpText: Root URL of the JEV API, without a trailing path. Example: https://api.typesafe.ai

field.label: Decision Endpoint Path
field.helpText: Path of the decision endpoint, appended to the Base URL.

field.label: API Key
field.helpText: JEV API key. Sent in the authentication header on every request.

field.label: Auth Header Name
field.helpText: HTTP header that carries the API key.

field.label: Auth Scheme
field.helpText: Prefix placed before the API key in the auth header (for example "Bearer"). Leave blank to send the raw key.

field.label: Default Model
field.helpText: Model used when the operation does not specify one.

field.label: Max Retries
field.helpText: Retries for rate limiting (429), server errors (502/503/504) and network failures. Uses exponential backoff and honours Retry-After.

field.label: Request Mode
field.helpText: Document Review: the input document becomes the JEV "state" and the Question Set below is applied. Raw Request: the input document is already a complete JEV request body.

field.label: Question Set (JSON)
field.helpText: JSON object of questions keyed by ID. Each question needs "type" (choice, score or noul) and "instructions". Choice questions also need "criteria" as an object of option ID to description; score questions need "criteria" as an array of 2 to 10 level descriptions, lowest first. Required in Document Review mode (or supplied per document).

field.label: Model
field.helpText: Overrides the connection's Default Model. Leave blank to use the default.

field.label: Document Format
field.helpText: How the input document is sent as state. Auto: valid JSON is sent as JSON, anything else as text. JSON: the document must be valid JSON. Text: always sent as a string.

field.label: State Wrapper Key
field.helpText: Optional. When set, the document is wrapped as {"<key>": document} before it is sent as state.

field.label: Confidence Threshold
field.helpText: Number between 0 and 1. Any answer below it marks the document NEEDS_REVIEW instead of DECIDED. Leave blank to disable gating.

field.label: Include Raw JEV Response
field.helpText: Adds the unmodified JEV response under "raw" in the output document.

field.label: Max Document Size (KB)
field.helpText: Documents larger than this are rejected before calling JEV.
